description: An English retelling that stays close to the folktale, following Ash-Lad’s chance meeting with a tiny grass-dwelling doll, her impossible shirt, a silver-spoon journey pulled by white mice, and a watery transformation that wins the king’s favor over the jealous brothers.
tone: Classic, wonder-filled folktale with gentle humor and a triumphant ending
summary: Cast aside by his brothers, Ash-Lad wins a magical bride from the grass whose transformation secures their happy future.
